# October 2026 final release coverage

Scope: October 1–31, 2026, America/New_York. Follow PSA `main` first-parent merge history so stacked work is counted when it reached main, not when its intermediate branch merged. There are no separate GitHub Release objects or tags for this month; mainline merges and production workflow runs are the release evidence.

Application review snapshot: `b06a4f98b` (November 3 checkout), filtered strictly to October. Final October application merge: `11fc6e77fd36433755506449e949020d5cff95d1` (PR #603, October 30). Docs base: `678dcf2`. The existing October 21 overview and September report were compared; September-only work is not treated as a new October release.

## Production evidence

The final October merge has a [successful Deploy Production run](https://github.com/EmryCyber/PSA/actions/runs/41076220503) created 2026-10-30T14:57:17Z. That workflow gates deployment on verification and image jobs, then migrates, deploys and checks health. All 225 workflow runs returned by the October UTC API window were paginated (100 + 100 + 25); release dates here use New York. Failed/superseded attempts are not counted as separate features. A successful deploy does not prove live acceptance of every connected provider.

## Coverage and availability

The final report follows September's area-by-area bullet format. October 21 history is retained; October 26 and October 30 changelog entries cover the remaining releases. The report and navigation use “October 2026 Release Notes.” Linked guides were updated for late-month invoice design/delivery, quote preview/products, AP PDFs/balance correction, MFA, vault QR enrollment and MSP unlink.

Zoho Books and vault TOTP stay rollout-dependent. Catalogs, review/release, agreement schedules, provider import/auto-send and AP PDF upload stay opt-in. AP PDF upload is QuickBooks accounting-route only, direct sending off; it does not include Xero/Zoho/direct-send PDFs. The AP balance repair includes a historical manual-review caveat. Organization invoice-design changes can affect later renders of older invoices. MSP unlink does not automatically revoke separately created users/API keys/webhooks.

RLS enforcement/family-model activation, role-based seat changes, compliance-overage V2 and MSP transfer remain separately controlled; groundwork is not advertised as enabled. Planned invoice editors/Canva letterheads, OData/Power BI, full calendar pull sync and new autopay schedulers are excluded. Security work is summarized without exploit details, customer data or credentials.

## Verification

Release claims were checked against mainline changes, existing guides and the October 22 coverage review. Key late-month implementation references in PSA: `docs/remediation-status/pr-ap-outstanding-amount.md`, `docs/remediation-status/pr-ap-pdf-upload.md`, `docs/invoice-pdf-layout-requests-2026-10-30.md`, `docs/invoice-templates-and-editor-plan-2026-10.md`, `docs/psa-quote-preview-and-products-plan-2026-10.md`, `docs/authenticator-choice-account-recovery-2026-10.md`, and the merged source for invoice delivery, vault QR controls and MSP unlink/feed cut-off.

This reviewer record lives under `.github/`, excluded from the Mintlify website. Private PSA links are provenance for authorized reviewers, not customer-facing links.

Documentation validation: `mint validate --no-build --format=json` passed with zero errors and zero warnings; `mint broken-links` found no broken links. Changed-page anchors, navigation targets and `git diff --check` passed. The strict preview build could not download its client because the environment proxy denied `releases.mintlify.com`; this is an infrastructure limitation, not a successful build. The CLI's temporary preview-cache path was redirected into `/workspace/work/` to avoid writes to the home directory; validation rules were unchanged. No application code was changed or application tests rerun.

The final application deploy's image, verification, and migrate/deploy jobs were also individually confirmed successful. Live-provider acceptance was not re-run.
